description: Edit ONE slide of an existing carousel post in place, the same as asking the in-app BAMF Bot to change one slide. Pass title/body/cta/content to change the slide copy, image_instruction to edit that slide's current image (everything else kept), or rerender=true to re-render a prompt-carousel page from its stored spec (hand-built prompt carousels re-render their cover and close; the spec is derived from the slides, caption keyword and author headshot). The prior slide copy/image is saved in carousel_slides[].text_versions/image_versions/versions. Always updates post_id; never creates a post. Slides are 1-based over the displayed (image) slides, the same numbering as the in-app BAMF Bot. Image edits return an async job; rebuild the PDF afterwards if the post has one.

content.description: Full slide copy; when omitted it is rebuilt from title/body/cta.

image_instruction.description: Edit this slide's current image. Requires images:generate.

rerender.description: Prompt carousels only (including hand-built ones): re-render this page (cover or close on hand-built decks) and rebuild the PDF; the previous image stays in versions and errors are returned.

name: bamf.edit_carousel_slide
